_about: Public-domain Constant Fouard (1837-1903, French priest and New Testament historian) in English for the Word Hoard: The Christ, the Son of God (2 vols, 1891), St. Peter (1893), St. Paul and his Missions (1894) and The Last Years of St. Paul (1900), tr. George F. X. Griffith, and St. John and the Close of the Apostolic Age (1905), all Longmans, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
